top_signals.title: Barclays, HSBC Say Warsh Boosts Case for Inflation-Linked Bonds
top_signals.summary: Barclays Plc and HSBC Holdings Plc say concern the Federal Reserve is dragging its feet on inflation is giving investors another reason to buy bonds that offer protection from accelerating price growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Africa Seeks Adviser for Eskom Spin-Off Creditor Talks
top_signals.summary: South Africa will hire advisers in the coming weeks to begin negotiations with lenders on a plan to spin off state-owned power utility Eskom Holdings SOC Ltd.’s transmission subsidiary, according to the head of the National Treasury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: AMD plummets 8% in premarket trading despite beating expectations
top_signals.summary: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
